title: shinyglass (development version)
text: Fix: bslib::sidebar() / page_sidebar() layout longer collapses full-width stack. Glass floating-sidebar rules now win bslib’s later position/width cascade, open sidebars reserve space main value boxes cards stay fully visible beside chrome (). Fix: nested layout_sidebar() longer double-floats. Inner sidebars keep glass styling use bslib’s -flow grid content pushed large empty gutter beside second absolute panel. Improve: AdminLTE chrome (classic shinydashboard bs4Dash) gets stronger glass overlay — translucent header/sidebar, soft-tinted value/info boxes, clearer menu active states — without breaking AdminLTE layout. Experimental: Shiny Python package python/ (CRAN). Reuses inst/scss + inst/js. Wheels vendor precompiled theme CSS + JS static/ default presets work without runtime libsass; custom knobs use optional shinyglass[theme].

title: shinyglass 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-28 Initial release. glass_theme() returns bslib theme Liquid Glass styling shiny apps: translucent surfaces, backdrop blur, soft depth, system typography. Light dark presets, options accent color, blur, saturation, corner radius. Works fluidPage(), navbarPage(), bslib::page_sidebar(), page functions accept bslib theme. Pass theme via theme = glass_theme(), teal apps via options(teal.bs_theme = glass_theme()). Styles common Bootstrap Shiny surfaces (cards, navbars, sidebars, inputs, tables, plots, modals) holds denser UIs leaflet maps, DT, shinyWidgets, bs4Dash, teal filter panels.
